table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Today = GETDATE(),
	StudentFeeSheetCode=StudentFeeSheetDetail.StudentFeeSheetCode,
	StudentCode=StudentFeeSheetDetail.StudentCode,
	StudentRegNo = Student.RegNo,
	StudentName = Student.Name,
	ClassCode=StudentFeeSheetDetail.ClassCode,
	ClassName = Class.Name,
	Grade = (SELECT Grade.Name FROM Grade WHERE Grade.GradeCode=Class.GradeCode),
	NumericGrade = (SELECT Grade.NumericalFactor FROM Grade WHERE Grade.GradeCode=Class.GradeCode),
	RollNo=StudentFeeSheetDetail.RollNo,
	ServiceCode=StudentFeeSheetDetail.ServiceCode,
	ServiceName = Service.Name,
	Fee=StudentFeeSheetDetail.Fee,
	FlatDisc=StudentFeeSheetDetail.FlatDisc,
	DiscPerc=StudentFeeSheetDetail.DiscPerc,
	FeePaidUptill=StudentFeeSheetDetail.FeePaidUptill,
	ServiceInvCode=StudentFeeSheetDetail.ServiceInvCode,
	StudentFeeSheetDetail.RowID,
	StudentFeeSheetDetail.ServiceTemplateCode,
	StudentFeeSheetDetail.DueDate
FROM
	StudentFeeSheetDetail, Student, Class, Service
WHERE 
	StudentFeeSheetDetail.StudentFeeSheetCode = :ai_code AND
	StudentFeeSheetDetail.StudentCode = Student.StudentCode AND
	StudentFeeSheetDetail.ClassCode = Class.ClassCode AND
	StudentFeeSheetDetail.ServiceCode = Service.ServiceCode
ORDER BY
	StudentFeeSheetCode,
	NumericGrade,
	ClassName,
	RollNo,
	StudentName
